initial.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06] Review findings remediation
initial.goal: Produce one complete disposition ledger for every accepted internal and external review finding.
initial.required_outcome: Every accepted #520/#521 finding appears exactly once with evidence, owner, disposition, review identity, and release consequence.
authority_boundary: Issue #522 owns the finding census and disposition ledger
Substantive fixes remain separately reviewable changes
Deferrals require explicit owner, rationale, target milestone, and release consequence
Release-blocking findings cannot be deferred silently
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Do not execute before #521 reviewed merge
Do not collapse distinct findings or fixes
Do not claim a fix from issue closure or green CI alone
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one complete finding-disposition ledger; individual remediations remain separately reviewable evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every accepted #520/#521 finding appears exactly once in the census
AC-2: Every substantive fix has exact-head review and meaningful proving validation
AC-3: Every deferral names owner, rationale, target milestone, and release consequence
AC-4: No release-blocking finding remains unresolved
AC-5: Counts and provenance reconcile across source reports and the ledger
dependencies: TAIL-05/#521 reviewed green merge is live
initial.plan_summary: After #521 merges, census every internal/external finding, preserve deduplication provenance, route each to a reviewed fix or explicit deferral, prove every disposition, and validate zero unresolved release blockers.

steps.action: Verify #521 reviewed merge and ingest every raw #520/#521 finding.
Deduplicate only identical root causes while preserving all source IDs and disagreements.
Route every accepted finding to a bounded fix or explicit owned deferral.
Verify exact-head review and proving validation for fixes and full metadata for deferrals.
Validate census parity, provenance, dispositions, and zero unresolved release blockers.

invariants: Every accepted finding is accounted for exactly once
Every substantive fix is independently reviewable
Every deferral is explicit and owned
risks: Green checks could be mistaken for semantic proof
A deferral could omit release consequence
Late fixes could stale review evidence
stop_conditions: A fix lacks exact-head review or meaningful proof

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove every #520/#521 finding appears exactly once with preserved provenance.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and ledger are #522 execution deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove each fix has exact-head review and meaningful validation and each deferral has complete ownership metadata.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and ledger are #522 execution deliverables.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency, census, provenance, proof, review, deferral, or release-blocker drift; never infer disposition from issue or CI state alone.
review_prompts: Does every accepted finding appear exactly once?
Do fixes have exact-head semantic proof rather than green CI alone?
Are deferrals explicit, owned, scheduled, and non-blocking?
Does any unresolved finding still block release?
initial.review_scope: Complete disposition of every accepted #520 and #521 finding, including exact-head fix evidence, explicit deferrals, and release consequence.
